name: prose diff isolates the changed word
description: One word replaced in a sentence. The engine descends paragraph to sentence to word and stops there, so the surrounding text stays in two unchanged segments rather than being torn into characters. Concatenating the "=" and "-" segments must rebuild the old text and "=" with "+" the new one; that invariant, not the exact segmentation, is what callers depend on.

request.body: {"old":"the quick brown fox","new":"the slow brown fox"}
